shortBulletSummary: Bitcoin faced over $2.8 billion in ETF outflows, with prices falling below $74,000 this week.
MicroStrategy announced an additional purchase of Bitcoin, reinforcing its accumulation strategy and institutional confidence.
The ECB signaled imminent rate hikes, while elevated US bond yields continue to divert capital, dampening overall crypto demand.
Over $1.5 billion in Bitcoin long positions were liquidated since May 25, linked to ongoing geopolitical tensions in the Middle East.
The FBI seized approximately $8 billion in cryptocurrency as part of a major operation against global scam networks.
